title: On Second Thought, Let’s Not Think Step by Step! Bias and Toxicity in Zero-Shot Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot reasoning on multiple-choice stereotype benchmarks (CrowS-Pairs, StereoSet, BBQ) to measure the rate of selecting unbiased 'Unknown' options versus racial stereotypes when using Chain-of-Thought prompting.
